## Summary

Describe the change in one or two paragraphs. Focus on the user-visible behavior or the developer workflow it improves.

## Verification

- [ ] `make test`
- [ ] `make test-integration`
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `make build`
- [ ] `make docker` or `make release-dry` when release tooling changed

## Notes

Call out follow-up work, intentional scope limits, or spec decisions reviewers should know about.
